title: Custom type recipe: material
summary: Proposed source-grounded additions for custom field construction and registration.

facts.claim: The pinned Material input extends FieldType from @ngx-formly/material/form-field, uses matInput with formControl and formlyAttributes bindings, and its module registers input with the form-field wrapper.
conditions: Using the Material adapter and its input integration.
limits: This is the built-in Material input pattern, not a guarantee that an arbitrary third-party widget implements MatFormFieldControl or a value accessor.
The Material form-field wrapper owns mat-form-field; avoid assuming a second nested wrapper is needed.
facts.context: Concrete Material custom-input reference pattern and adapter-specific imports.
